title: A Snack for the Pug
sentences: Fran had a plan and a snack for the pug.
The pug sat in the hut.
Fran had a tan cup and a black cup.
She put the tan cup on the snack.
She set the black cup on the deck.
The pug gave the black cup a sniff.
It gave the tan cup a sniff.
Then the pug sat at the tan cup.
Fran got the cup off, and the pug got the snack.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What did the pug do at the tan cup?
answers: It gave the black cup a sniff.
It sat at the tan cup.
